$comment: Member kinds this lexicon supplies to a chant workspace (#2545). chant reads this file as data and never imports the lexicon. Both probes are behold's, narrowed to the member's own directory: a choudoufu estate is a Terraform root with an estate.chdf.hcl sidecar or a live block, and the lexicon's choudoufu mode (#2103) reads it, so the kind lives here. Each kind's graph block is how chant workspace graph reads a member (#2874): a reader project with this lexicon and one root named for the member, with moduleRoot at the workspace root so a member's ../modules calls stay readable. The pulumi kind (#3179) is here because no lexicon knows Pulumi and this one already supplies the other infrastructure-as-code engines' kinds; its graph block reads the pulumi stack export checked in beside Pulumi.yaml as stack-export.json (src/workspace-member.ts); chant never runs the program, and with no export the member has no nodes and meta.pulumiMember says why.

kinds.name: terraform
kinds.description: a Terraform root module, with a .tf file directly in its directory

kinds.name: choudoufu
kinds.description: a choudoufu estate: a Terraform root with an estate.chdf.hcl sidecar or a live block in one of its .tf files

kinds.name: pulumi
kinds.description: a Pulumi program, with a Pulumi.yaml in its directory
